cover.desc: Cover page with title, subtitle and an Open button. start (anchor the button opens, default index), button (default Open planner; "Open journal" also makes printed help say journal), size (title px)

index.desc: Contents page: a card for every section plus all months

year.desc: Year at a glance: 12 mini calendars, every date links to its day (dated) or month (undated)

lined.desc: Lined or dot-grid writing pages (notes, goals, brain dump). label, kicker, pages, dots, anchor

checklist.desc: Checklist page in columns. label, kicker, groups: [[title, [items]]], anchor

table.desc: Table page. label, kicker, headers, rows, first_column (pre-filled), anchor, check_columns (headers drawn as a narrow column of tick boxes), dividers (column rules)

year_pixels.desc: Year in pixels: color one square per day for mood or energy. label, keys

guide.desc: Printed guide page with numbered steps (how to start, how to import, how links work). label, kicker, steps: [[title, text]], tip, anchor

link_test.desc: Setup check page: buttons that jump to a test page and back, so buyers confirm links work before planning. label, anchor

calendar.desc: The dated or undated calendar: month pages, optional habit page per month, week pages and day pages, all cross-linked. month: {side: [labels]}, habits: bool, week: {preset | side: [blocks]}, day: {preset | left: [blocks], right: [blocks]}, days: bool

params.iso_weeks: bool: ISO 8601 week numbers (Week 1 holds January 4); needs a head_start covering the days before it

head_start.desc: Lead-in months before the main dated year (for example Nov and Dec 2026 in a 2027 planner): month pages whose dates link to lead-in week pages, Monday-start week pages titled by date range, optional lead-in day pages. Anchors use their own prefix. The last week links days that fall in the main year to their day pages and offers Continue to the main year. label, kicker, anchor (prefix, default hs), from YYYY-MM, to YYYY-MM, days bool, month {side}, week {preset|side}, day {preset|left,right}, continue_to (default m01)

params.label: str
params.main_links: bool: on head-start pages the head-start month tabs say their year (NOV 2026) so one label has one target, the last head-start week arrow opens main Week 1 and Week 1 gets a back arrow

money_month.desc: One month-end money page per month (anchors mm01 to mm12; with head_start also mmhs11, mmhs12 for the head-start months), each linked from its month page by a chip. Two tables (Money in, Money out: Category, Planned, Actual, Total row), a This month box (Money in, Money out, Profit), lined boxes for fields (the last fills the page) and a strip of pills to every Money month. One Contents card and one top-bar item. label, kicker, anchor, nav_label, head_start, income, expenses, fields

params.label: str (Money month)
params.head_start: bool: also pages for the head_start months
params.fields: list of str: lined boxes, the last grows

eink_format.desc: Format switch for e-ink tablets (reMarkable): prints no page. Put it first in sections. Widens the left gutter to left_gutter px (clears the toolbar), draws writing lines and dot grids as vector strokes instead of gradient patterns (vector_rules), refuses a theme with any color when grayscale is true and drops the month and card tints, lays portrait week pages (calendar and head start) out as two columns of day boxes with the side blocks underneath (week_layout rows), and replaces the Setup check fix list and pen test label (link_test_fixes, pen_label). In portrait the Setup check also gets a map of the top bar under the pen test.

books.desc: Book log (Library) plus one review page per book, cross-linked both ways. Library pages (anchor, then anchor2, anchor3...): per_log_page numbered lines (No., Title, Author, Finished, Stars, Shelf); each number opens that book; a strip links all Library pages. Book pages (book_anchor + 001...): title, author, genre, format, dates, pages, stars, reread, why I picked it up, thoughts (fills the page), favorite quote with page, favorite character, one-line review; previous and next book arrows; trail back to the Library page holding its line. One Contents card and one top-bar item. label, kicker, anchor, book_anchor, count, per_log_page

reading_month.desc: Twelve undated monthly reading pages, anchors m01 to m12 (the month rail and Contents month grid link to them): books finished this month with stars, 31 reading-day circles, pages or hours read, book of the month, up next, notes. Trail Reading year / Month. Registers nothing unless index or nav is true. label, index, nav

reading_year.desc: One undated reading-year page (anchor 'year'): yearly book goal with a year field, month by month rows (each month links to m01 to m12) with 10 squares to color per finished book, tallies (Fiction, Nonfiction, Print, Ebook, Audio), top 5 of the year, best quote of the year. Registers a Contents card and, unless nav is false, a top-bar item. label, kicker, anchor, nav

blocks.dots: Dot-grid box. label, grow or height
blocks.scale: Circles 1 to max to rate energy, mood or focus. label, max
blocks.hours: Hourly schedule. label, from, to, row (px)

style_rules.rule: Every page must be reachable by links from the first page. Groups of pages that only link to each other count as unreachable.
Setup steps must work for a buyer on any purchase date in the selling window, for example before the dated year starts. Walk through day one for an early buyer and a mid-year buyer.
Every number or fact in the listing (pages, file size, what is and isn't included) must match the built file. Rebuilds change counts; update the copy.
Use only glyphs the embedded fonts contain. Draw arrows and icons as SVG, otherwise a non-licensed fallback font gets embedded.
A listing photo must show what its copy and alt text claim. A small multi-page grid needs captions and readable pages (2x2 beats 4 in a row).
No half-empty pages. Fill spare space with something a buyer uses (a map of the top bar, a month jump grid, a pen test area), never decoration.
Never promise service levels in the product (for example 'we reply fast'). Say what the buyer can do instead.
A week that spans two months is built once, under the month that holds its Thursday; day pages name their own month in the trail.
Spreadsheets: never rely on a feature Google Sheets drops on import (data bars, Excel-only functions, external-style '#Sheet' links). Use text bars, functions both apps share, and internal tab links.
Every input cell must change at least one result. An input that nothing reads is a broken promise.
style_rules.from: coverage check, Clear Budget round 1 (Debt 'Extra each month')

style_rules.rule: Size every list for the worst real case (weekly pay has 53 paydays a year; a month can hold 80+ purchases), or say plainly where it stops.
Only input cells are shaded. Labels, totals and formulas are never shaded like inputs.
Listing photos must be readable at Etsy's zoom: show the useful part of a page or tab, large, never a whole page shrunk to fit. Alt text and points describe only what is in frame.
Start-up steps cover a buyer who buys before the product's year starts (Oct to Dec) as well as one who buys mid-year.

Price inside the market's best-earning range, never under it: at least the revenue-weighted median price (what buyers actually pay, weighted by sales). A low price makes a good product look cheap. While the shop has few reviews, launch with a time-limited Etsy sale (25% off for 30 days) on the full price instead of a low price.
style_rules.from: Darren and Colynne, Oct 22 2026 (Canva course advice, confirmed by our price data)

style_rules.rule: At most two font families per product: one for headings, one for body. Build hierarchy with weight, size and italic, not extra typefaces. Too many fonts tires the eyes.
style_rules.from: Colynne's review of p-rjd-001, Oct 23 2026 (fix: fonts)
